description: Archaeological monitoring of wetland area produced Late Roman material, including coins, pottery, and a column base. The material was tightly dated to the mid 3rd to mid/late 4th CE, and was used to suggest that a religious function may be likely for the site, no further investigations were made.
bibliography: Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “River Idle Washlands, Bawtry (South Yorkshire).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
